entities.title: Ship AI
entities.summary: How every non-player object thinks, launches its children and becomes angry.
entities.purpose: Decides each think of every thinking object (RULES C.5): when it is due, the missile AI, the ship AI and its steering, launching police, pods, missiles, drones and canisters, and the anger a hit causes. A think changes the bubble and the cockpit but never the pilot: damage and kills come back in a Thought for combat to apply.
boundaries: A capability: it uses no feature or use case (tests/layers.rs).
The player's side of a fight is the combat capability's.
